description: This file defines the class BasicPasswordEncodablePlatformUser, a domain model representing a platform user with password encryption capabilities in the Apache Fineract security module.

classes.name: BasicPasswordEncodablePlatformUser
classes.description: Represents a user with password and username, implements PlatformUser interface, with basic security status methods and Lombok annotations for boilerplate code.

methods.name: getUsername
methods.description: Returns the username of the user.

methods.name: getPassword
methods.description: Returns the password of the user.

methods.name: getAuthorities
methods.description: Returns the authorities granted to the user; currently returns null.

methods.name: isAccountNonExpired
methods.description: Indicates whether the user's account has not expired; currently returns false.

methods.name: isAccountNonLocked
methods.description: Indicates whether the user's account is not locked; currently returns false.

methods.name: isCredentialsNonExpired
methods.description: Indicates whether the user's credentials have not expired; currently returns false.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Indicates whether the user is enabled; currently returns false.
